the design of a Big Data tool for mapping short reads in RNA seq datasets.

The main takeaway from our work is that
Big Data tools can be built on top of existing state of the art tools, without the need to rewrite them, to achieve significant performance gains.

, by using a state of the artwork aligner as a building block, it is possible to achieve a high performance and accurate RNA read mapper that can efficiently scale to large datasets and distributed memory systems.
